description: Single-canonical-authority registry. Each entry declares the ONE authoritative artifact for a semantic domain, the legacy definitions it supersedes, and the derived projections it generates. This is data, not code: tools/authority/check_authority.py reads it and enforces the invariant that no semantic domain has more than one authority.

superseded.note: Pre-WRP draft schema, superseded by the canonical WorkRequest IR and deleted from the working tree (D-2026-08-16-003). Tombstone is the durable provenance record; do not resurrect.

authorities.note: Canonical WorkRequest IR (3-layer, 11-state). Splits intent vs event-derived state: `metadata.mode` is the 3-layer IR mode (ir_layer: INTENT/BINDING/EXECUTION-BOUND), while `execution_state` + `status` are event-derived runtime state (execution_state/execution_status). The pre-WRP draft .agents/schema/work_request.schema.json was superseded and deleted; it is recorded as a tombstoned superseded artifact (durable provenance, no resurrection). schemas/ontology/core/work-request.jsonld is the JSON-LD graph form.

Legacy seven-state WorkRequest DCO (conduit), hand-maintained pydantic models. NOT a projection of the eleven-state WRP machine (schemas/validation/wrp/work-request.schema.json) — it is a distinct legacy domain per D-2026-08-16-003. Explicit migration edge to the `work_request` domain kept for the future WRP flip (when the real generator/semantic mapping lands).
WRP lifecycle event envelope (additive-only versioning). schemas/ontology/core/event.jsonld is the JSON-LD graph form.
WRP 11-state lifecycle and adjacency matrix. Distinct from the CCNF PGV phase machine (go/wrp/ccnf-ref/.tools/pgv.state_machine.json), which governs CCNF phases, not WR status.
Pure PEB domain types (no framework/db imports). The TypeSpec-generated client models are a projection; TypeSpec provenance reconciliation is tracked separately.
Go CCNF reference is the authority oracle. The Rust ccnf-verifier is the cross-language conformance projection.

Canonical graph type definition. The SQL projection is regenerated from it. GraphSnapshot/VectorSnapshot (knowledge-graph.jsonld, extensions/vector-snapshot.jsonld) and graph-data backups (graph/nexus-knowledge-graph.json.bak/.pre-rebuild) are GENERATED PROJECTIONS — point-in-time artifacts that never carry canonical authority.

Canonical coordination contract for leased execution. The Supervisor coordinates grants, attempts, claims, evidence, SOL evaluation, settlement requests, and recovery, but PEB/kernel owns admission and settlement, SOL/resolution owns semantic evaluation, lease infrastructure owns lease lifecycle, and projections have no authority.

Physical anchor: schemas/migrations/resolution (the versioned DDL chain that defines resolution.concept/attribute/relationship/expression/rule/verified_statement + v28/v29 proposition layer; live authority is the applied PostgreSQL resolution schema). D-2026-08-23-B: the resolution schema IS the SOL IR substrate and the canonical logical authority (L1 in the four-layer model). Serializers: JSON-LD ontology (schemas/ontology/, L2) and canonical-JSON; evaluators: SQL today. Downstream forms - TypeSpec/JSON Schema/CUE service-contract projections (L3) and python/ir, CCNF, ProjectionIR, Mongo snapshots, graph exports (L4) - are receipt-carrying projections with NO reverse authority path. Logical authority ownership: DBA+architect (schema chain); nothing named sol-ir outside resolution.* may claim operational authority.
